cloud.one_shell.label: One Cloud shell for every account
cloud.one_shell.about: Every Cloud account opens the same pages, wherever its songs are kept. An account whose songs are only in its cloud library gets them without anything about this device: no connecting music, no folder checks and no This device place. Adding music means uploading, songs play from the cloud library on any device, and Make a Mix is the mixer everyone has, playing through the same player that other devices, Rooms and Lucy can reach. Music on the member's devices then only adds what belongs to a device. It needs the Library to say where songs are kept, so a song can be removed from the cloud library there, and the account's mixes kept in one place, so mixes made on the older pages are in My Mixes. Off: an account without music on its devices keeps its own cloud library pages.
